title: The Allotment Rose Cultivar Construction Register
created_from: Recovered library previews: six starter records plus Rose Collection Batch 002 twelve RHS-linked records
batch1_documented_total_note: Batch 002 says twenty total with Batch 001 (8); only six original starter records are recovered from stored index preview. Two Batch 001 identities remain unrecovered. DO NOT invent records.

records.name: Rosa Mundi
records.description: Semi-double, golden stamens; Striped crimson, pink and white
records.louise: Compact gallica shrub; striped five-to-many-petal flower decals, open gold center, autumn hips.
records.model_brief: Compact gallica shrub; striped five-to-many-petal flower decals, open gold center, autumn hips.

records.name: Old Blush
records.description: Loose semi-double to double; Blush to silvery pink
records.louise: Airy China-rose shrub with loose pink flower clusters, smooth oval foliage, recurrent buds.
records.model_brief: Airy China-rose shrub with loose pink flower clusters, smooth oval foliage, recurrent buds.

records.name: Souvenir de la Malmaison
records.description: Full, cupped to quartered; Soft porcelain pink
records.louise: Rounded bush, many layered flattened rose cups, pale pink; rainy-condition bloom stress can be modeled.
records.model_brief: Rounded bush, many layered flattened rose cups, pale pink; rainy-condition bloom stress can be modeled.

records.name: Gertrude Jekyll
records.description: Very full old-fashioned rosette; Deep clear pink
records.louise: Tall branching climber frame or upright shrub; large full pink rosette cluster meshes.
records.model_brief: Tall branching climber frame or upright shrub; large full pink rosette cluster meshes.

records.name: Graham Thomas
records.description: Deep golden cup; Warm rich yellow
records.louise: Climber with vertical cane structure; simple broad golden cup blooms and medium green leaf clusters.
records.model_brief: Climber with vertical cane structure; simple broad golden cup blooms and medium green leaf clusters.

records.name: Golden Celebration
records.description: Large many-petaled cup; Deep golden yellow
records.louise: Rounded arching shrub, oversized golden cups, leaf clusters on arching branches.
records.model_brief: Rounded arching shrub, oversized golden cups, leaf clusters on arching branches.

records.name: Charles de Mills
records.description: Fully double, quartered crimson-purple flowers, sometimes with a green eye; very fragrant.
records.louise: Quartered bloom. Notice the four petal sections.

records.name: Celsiana
records.description: Nodding clusters of clear-pink, fragrant, semi-double flowers that fade to pinkish-white.

records.name: Fantin-Latour
records.description: Very fragrant, flat, very double blush-pink blooms, sometimes with a green eye.
records.louise: Full blush flowers. See the green eye.

records.name: Louise Odier
records.description: Very fragrant, cup-shaped, fully double bright-pink flowers with lilac shading, clustered from summer into autumn.
records.louise: Cupped blooms flatten as they age.

records.name: Mary Rose
records.description: Very fragrant, cupped loose-petalled double rose-pink flowers, about 8–9 cm across.
records.louise: Loose petals make this a softer-looking double.

records.name: Heritage
records.description: Very fragrant, fully double, shell-pink cupped flowers in clusters.
records.louise: Shell-pink cups. Notice the petal layering.

records.name: Munstead Wood
records.description: Large scented cupped flowers, crimson in bud and opening to rich dark blackcurrant tones.
records.louise: Dark crimson buds open to rich blackcurrant shades.

records.name: The Pilgrim
records.description: Soft yellow rosette flowers, pale lemon-white at the outer petals; flowers summer to autumn.
records.mature_size_text: Different shrub and climber forms — consult RHS link
records.louise: Shrub or climber — the support changes its form.

records.name: Abraham Darby
records.description: Large, very fragrant, fully double flowers shifting from apricot and yellow toward coral-pink with age.
records.louise: Flowers change color as they age.

records.name: Jude the Obscure
records.description: Large very fragrant, fully double goblet-shaped yellow flowers flushed pale peach or apricot.

records.name: Reine des Violettes
records.description: Very fragrant fully double, quartered rosettes in lilac to pale-purple tones.

records.name: Lady of Shalott
records.description: Double flowers with salmon-pink upper petals and golden-yellow reverses, giving an apricot effect.

implementation_contract.scientific_layer: All fields are research leads pending cultivar-by-cultivar verification; missing dimensions and parentage stay null.
implementation_contract.godot: Use cultivar-specific stable IDs and reference these separate from generic rose or climbing_rose plants. Do not place cultivar items in existing shop without model and state integration.
implementation_contract.art: Differentiate flowers by color, petal form, shape, layering, leaf, thorns/prickles, bush architecture, blossom clusters; do not reuse generic rose model as an accurate cultivar likeness.
implementation_contract.behavior: Cultivar-specific bloom repeat, growth habit and pruning; age measured in real days and years. Individual data must be source checked before simulation.
implementation_contract.tests: Record uniqueness, source URL presence, exactly 18 recoverable entries, no new plant IDs overriding saved IDs, separate arch eligibility, legacy shop unaffected.
